title: Non-linear screening of spherical and cylindrical colloids: the case of 1:2 and 2:1 electrolytes
abstract: From a multiple scale analysis, we find an analytic solution of spherical and cylindrical Poisson-Boltzmann theory for both a 1:2 (monovalent co-ions, divalent counter-ions) and a 2:1 (reversed situation) electrolyte. Our approach consists in an expansion in powers of rescaled curvature $1/(κa)$, where $a$ is the colloidal radius and $1/κ$ the Debye length of the electrolytic solution. A systematic comparison with the full numerical solution of the problem shows that for cylinders and spheres, our results are accurate as soon as $κa>1$. We also report an unusual overshooting effect where the colloidal effective charge is larger than the bare one.
